Stop on breach; explain in the report.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `the form's rule scope in objectstack (ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx, ruleRecord: null seed, then the record as last read, then the live inputs; no formula is computed) | none: the server computes formulas for the write only, no read door serves a formula over unsaved inputs | every console and HotCRM user filling a create or edit form whose required field's visibleWhen reads a formula`
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds
Serial constraints cleared: `#35050 (area o1-B, claim names form.tsx prefill seeding; no PR yet) and PR #34978 (#34905, Tier H, open; adds a describe to ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/fieldRules.test.ts, so this card's tests go in new files). overlap-check.mjs runs before every push.`

Pre-claim lane: `domain:ui`: the fix lands in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` and `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/` (ui/** per the lane table), no server or spec path.
Pre-claim deps: the card names no `Blocked-by:` and no "after #N". It follows #34905; its server half (PR #34978) is open and not a dependency: the form's recompute is right on main and on #34978 alike. Hot file `form.tsx` is shared with #35050's claim (no PR yet); queued by overlap-check, not by name.
Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 35033` (381 hits, broad) and `--terms recompute,recomputed,visibleWhen,formula,preview` (34 hits): no ADR decides a client formula recompute or a server formula preview. Read and bound: #34905 ruling record 6956761249 (route A; item 3 "A faulting or unevaluable `visibleWhen` falls back to today's always-required behaviour"); contract review 6963978999 finding S3 (this card's origin); ADR-0124 (server enforces, client is courtesy); ui ADR-0036 (field rules evaluate with the canonical `@objectstack/formula` engine). Thread: no comments.

Premise reading on `origin/main` 526282e1: `ruleRecord` in `form.tsx` seeds every field `null`, overlays the record as last read, then the watched values; `git grep -iE "applyFormula|computeFormula|recomputeFormula|formulaValues" -- ui/packages` outside tests: 0 hits (positive control: `ruleRecord` itself, found). So a formula field reads `null` on create and its served value on edit, as the card says.

Route (the seat's choice, not a ruling; veto window): compute in the form, over the live inputs, with the same `@objectstack/formula` engine the field rules already use (ui ADR-0036), formulas in the platform's read order (`formulaReadOrder`). The form answers a formula that does not compute exactly as the server does on PR #34978's head (its body, seat S2 ruling): a fault a read shares (an operator over an empty operand, an undeclared key, a cycle) gives `null` and the predicate is judged on that `null`; a value only a read can have (a hop, `label()`, `current_user.can()`, or a formula that reads one at any depth) makes the predicate unevaluable, so the field shows. No server preview door: it would add a public REST surface for what the canonical engine already does in the browser. No server, spec or ADR path is in this card; the "Known limit (S3)" prose #34978 adds is a follow-up the seat files once both have landed.

Claim amendment 1 · 2026-11-18T04:11Z (amends claim 6968471929 after dev report 6968778389, which returned `needs_decision` with two questions; both are answered here as seat routing, not as maintainer rulings, veto window open)

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new member on the `@object-ui/core` package entry (the client formula pass, `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/formulaRecord.ts`), nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none
File surface: as in the claim, plus `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/index.ts` (the one re-export line), `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/**` hooks beside `form.tsx`, and `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` only if the dev measures it as a live create/edit renderer that judges `visibleWhen` over the same record (same defect, same helper; otherwise it stays a note).

Q1 (how `form.tsx` reaches the pass): route A, export from `@object-ui/core`'s entry. Reasons read on 526282e1: `form.tsx` already imports `resolveFieldRuleState`, `evalFieldPredicate` and nine other evaluator members from `@object-ui/core` (line 9), and `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/index.ts` re-exports `./fieldRules.js` whole; precedent for a new core member declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `.changeset/34173-aggregate-bulk-rejection-one-outcome.md`. Route B is refused: engine logic in `@object-ui/components` breaks the ui topology. Route C (server preview) stays out: a new REST surface for what the browser already computes.
Q2 (a `visibleWhen` reading an unservable formula): route A, the field is shown and required, with one warning, and the client does not refuse submit for it. That is the server's answer under ruling record 6956761249 item 3 ("A faulting or unevaluable `visibleWhen` falls back to today's always-required behaviour") and the client must not be stricter than the server (ADR-0124). Route B would refuse a write the server accepts once the field is filled.

Review owed: the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone owes a TIER_DEFAULT contract record (contract-review.md), run by the seat side, plus L1-a.

**Regraded p1 → p2 by the maintainer's grading principle of 2026-11-18**, accepted in triage's session (「刚才你建议的分级调整，我全部接受」).

The principle, in order:
1. What a new user or a prospect meets first (looks and the main flow), the cloud core (Turso, hosted sign-up and onboarding, hosted install and upgrade, plans) and a developer's first contact come first.
2. Data loss or a permission breach in normal use stays first.
3. Details and rare configurations are improved over time.
4. Internal items are frozen.

Why this card: detail / rare configuration: a formula-driven visibleWhen on a required field.
